artifacts.source: index.html head title, description, Open Graph, theme color, and favicon declarations
artifacts.destination: Use route-specific Lab metadata without an unverified broadcast schedule or standalone canonical claim.
artifacts.followUp: Verify hosted RazonWorks canonicals and social assets before publishing or redirecting.

artifacts.source: Organization, Person, and WebSite nodes in the JSON-LD graph
artifacts.destination: Model Razon Lab as the experimental arm of RazonWorks with only verified identity links.
artifacts.followUp: Review publisher, founder, job-title, sameAs, language, and ownership assertions against current evidence.

artifacts.source: BroadcastEvent and Schedule nodes in the JSON-LD graph
artifacts.destination: Publish event schema only for a currently verified recurring or scheduled broadcast.
artifacts.followUp: Verify the stream exists, its service, days, times, timezone, and live status before preserving any event fields.

artifacts.source: Hero name, bilingual tag, live-status line, description, and watch actions
artifacts.destination: Explain the Lab evidence contract and lead with an inspectable experiment or artifact.
artifacts.followUp: Remove schedule and live-channel assertions unless independently verified.

artifacts.source: Monday-Friday 6:00-8:00 PM Central schedule and notification copy
artifacts.destination: Show a schedule only when its current source and owner are recorded.
artifacts.followUp: Verify current days, time, timezone, platform, and notification behavior.

artifacts.source: Question, initial model, attempt, abstraction check, failure, and updated-model loop
artifacts.destination: Adapt the six-step loop as a method field or experiment template, not proof that a broadcast occurred.
artifacts.followUp: Remove duplicated wording and localize the method completely in the paired routes.

artifacts.destination: Carry forward as a publication safety rule with explicit scope and enforcement guidance.
artifacts.followUp: Treat the source as a stated rule, not evidence that every historical stream complied.

artifacts.source: YouTube, Twitch, X, and GitHub values in LINKS and sameAs arrays
artifacts.destination: Link only to channels whose current ownership, handle, and content purpose are verified.
artifacts.followUp: Open each public URL, confirm owner and destination, and record the verification date.

artifacts.source: PromptDefenders, High Encode Learning, CSBrain AI, and DavidTiz related-work cards
artifacts.destination: Use contextual artifact links only; do not recreate a generic sibling-property directory.
artifacts.followUp: Preserve only a link that materially helps interpret a specific experiment.

artifacts.source: hello@razonlab.com and broad work, collaboration, and question invitation
artifacts.destination: Use a verified Lab-specific research contact or omit the action.
artifacts.followUp: Verify mailbox ownership, delivery, retention, response expectations, and portfolio routing.

artifacts.source: Watch, Schedule, Series, and Contact in-page navigation
artifacts.destination: Prioritize records, method, evidence status, limitations, artifacts, and next test.
artifacts.followUp: Map labels separately for English and Spanish after the integrated route content is final.

artifacts.destination: Retain as a provenance asset until the RazonWorks identity review decides its final use.
artifacts.followUp: Check contrast, sizes, license, and integrated-brand fit before publication.

artifacts.destination: Create route-owned Lab social art only after title and evidence framing are approved.
artifacts.followUp: Preserve the original digest for provenance and verify the replacement at 1200 x 630.

artifacts.source: Final HTML comment suggesting a future analytics snippet
artifacts.destination: Use only RazonWorks-approved analytics with its existing consent and evidence contracts.
